title: New Customer from New Work Order has Credit Terms prefilled too
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Choose a name for the new customer, customer A.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Work Order".
  2. Choose to add a new customer from the customer picker.
  3. Type the name of customer A in Customer Name.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Open customer A's customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The same "New Customer" window opens, with Credit Terms reading Net 30 (Default) and Credit Limit beside it.

Step 3:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and customer A is picked as the work order's customer.

Step 5:

  • The "Credit term" reads Net 30.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R15: “Every customer created in the app (from the Customers page, New Work Order and New Part Sale) is created in this New Customer window, so this story covers all of them. Imports and the Public API are the only other ways to create a customer (Story 10: Imports and Public API); the Counter Sale customer is created with the organization and always on COD.”
  • S5-R2: “On New Customer, Credit Terms is prefilled with the shop's default.”
